description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a project detail page, including sections like project about, needs, general information, gallery, social commitment, and SDGs.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents the project data model with properties like description, gallery, about, motivation, goal, social commitment, and related media.

classes.name: ImageData
classes.description: Handles image data and provides methods to get image links and names.

methods.name: getSocialCommitment
methods.description: Returns the social commitment object associated with the project.

methods.name: getSdgs
methods.description: Fetches the list of SDGs associated with the project.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon image data for a social commitment.
